question: At matched40000 updates, does the already-reviewed n3 latent geometry track controlled-ball and environment-ball position changes?
hypothesis: Noncollapsed latent geometry can emphasize environment positions over control positions. This is an exploratory geometric diagnostic, not proof of information absence or planning success.

sources.consequence: Measure physical-state accessibility separately from latent loss, distinguish linear readout from absent information, disclose smaller local ridge protocol and auxiliary-head gradient deviation; do not infer planning success.
Use train-only population moments with frozen learned weights; batch-statistic evaluation is a diagnostic, not the deployed inference policy.

contrary_evidence: Low Euclidean-distance correlation can coexist with nonlinearly encoded information or distance scaling dominated by other factors. Pairs share observations/episodes and are not2000 independent samples. Good correlation alone does not establish action-conditioned prediction or planning. A004 runtime wait has no established relation to representation quality.

protocol.preflight: Require passing A002 review and exact per-case source digest/float64_math checks; load CPU, cast to float64, math attention, eval mode. Confirm checkpoint/model state unchanged and CUDA not initialized.
protocol.data: Validation split only; exactly5 randomly selected frames per each100 episodes, fixed seed2026111519. Match cases across both checkpoints; no test split, no train fit.
protocol.pairs: 2000 fixed random index pairs with endpoints from different episodes. Latent L2; red XY L2; white-set root summed squared distance under Hungarian correspondence. Spearman rank correlation for red and white separately; retain latent mean distance and per-coordinate latent standard deviation.
protocol.uncertainty: Exploratory point estimates only, no p-values or independent-pair confidence claims. Restrict conclusions to these matched intermediate checkpoints and sampled validation scenes.
protocol.verification: Check finite features/distances, batch32 versus single and reversed grouping on first8 observations at rtol1e-4/atol1e-5, byte-identical source and unchanged model state. Save sampled indices, distances, hashes and standalone scatter plot.
protocol.interpretation: Consult full paper sections3,5.1,A.10 after result; distinguish latent geometry from linear decoding, prediction and planning. Do not pass any final P25/P26 gate from this reference.

success: Produce a bounded, reproducible geometry measurement and a literature-bound provisional interpretation regardless of correlation sign/magnitude.
stop: Stop on invalid parent/digest, nonfinite/grouping mismatch or CPU wall time above180seconds. Do not initialize GPU or fit/update parameters.
